intro.title: Recursive TreeView
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a TreeView component that can display nested data structures, like a folder system, using recursion. You will learn how a React component can call itself to render deeply nested items, which is the core programming concept of recursion. The main technologies involved are React functional components, TypeScript interfaces for type-safe data, and conditional rendering. By the end, you will have a working, expandable tree that visually represents hierarchical relationships.
intro.usecase: Recursive TreeView components are essential for displaying hierarchical data structures in modern applications. You'll find them in file explorers like VS Code's sidebar, where folders can contain subfolders and files. They're also used in organizational charts, nested comment threads on platforms like Reddit, and complex navigation menus in admin dashboards. As a developer, implementing recursive TreeViews helps you efficiently render deeply nested data while maintaining clean, reusable component architecture.
